item.title: I Generated 8 Books in One Day. Here's What Nobody Tells You About the Part After That.
item.description: Eight full-length manuscripts in a single day, and two months later not one of them is published. An honest account of automating the fast half of a job and calling it progress.

item.title: What Claude Code Actually Does That ChatGPT Doesn't (A Non-Engineer's Take)
item.description: Not a benchmark comparison. Four things I watched Claude Code do on my own machine that a chat window structurally can't, plus the parts where it left the work to me.

item.title: I Built a Self-Updating Blog for $12 a Year — Here's the Whole Setup
item.description: The full build log for this site: GitHub Pages, a custom domain, and a Python publishing pipeline I wrote myself. Real costs, real mistakes, and the month it quietly stopped working.
